name: add_k8s_ingress_tls_routing
description: Authors an Ingress with TLS and host-based routing to an existing Service
prompts: k8s/service.yaml (already present, do not modify it) defines the ClusterIP Service 'web-service' on port 80. Create k8s/ingress.yaml defining an Ingress that exposes it externally: apiVersion networking.k8s.io/v1, kind Ingress, metadata.name web-ingress; spec.tls with a single entry whose hosts list contains "app.example.com" and whose secretName is "web-tls-cert"; spec.rules with a single rule for host "app.example.com" routing path "/" (pathType Prefix) to backend service "web-service" on port 80. TLS must actually be configured - do not leave the connection as plain HTTP.

setup_files.k8s/service.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web-service
spec:
  selector:
    app: web
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080

test_setup_files.test_ingress.py:
import yaml

with open('k8s/ingress.yaml') as f:
    d = yaml.safe_load(f)

assert d.get('apiVersion') == 'networking.k8s.io/v1', d.get('apiVersion')
assert d.get('kind') == 'Ingress', d.get('kind')
assert d.get('metadata', {}).get('name') == 'web-ingress'

spec = d['spec']
tls = spec.get('tls')
assert tls and isinstance(tls, list) and len(tls) >= 1, 'spec.tls must be a non-empty list'
t0 = tls[0]
assert 'app.example.com' in (t0.get('hosts') or []), 'tls hosts must include app.example.com'
assert t0.get('secretName') == 'web-tls-cert', f"tls secretName must be web-tls-cert, got {t0.get('secretName')!r}"

rules = spec.get('rules')
assert rules and len(rules) >= 1, 'spec.rules must be non-empty'
r0 = rules[0]
assert r0.get('host') == 'app.example.com', f"rule host must be app.example.com, got {r0.get('host')!r}"

paths = r0['http']['paths']
assert len(paths) >= 1
p0 = paths[0]
assert p0.get('path') == '/', p0.get('path')
assert p0.get('pathType') == 'Prefix', p0.get('pathType')

backend = p0['backend']['service']
assert backend.get('name') == 'web-service', f"backend service name must be web-service, got {backend.get('name')!r}"
assert backend['port'].get('number') == 80, f"backend service port must be 80, got {backend['port'].get('number')!r}"

# service.yaml untouched
with open('k8s/service.yaml') as f:
    svc = yaml.safe_load(f)
assert svc['spec']['ports'][0]['port'] == 80, 'service.yaml was modified'

print('PASS')

reference_solution.k8s/ingress.yaml:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: web-ingress
spec:
  tls:
    - hosts:
        - app.example.com
      secretName: web-tls-cert
  rules:
    - host: app.example.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: web-service
                port:
                  number: 80
